subject: Packaging PT Report & Owner Action Plan for CatalystBank SIG
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CatalystBank PT report — packaging + internal owners needed

Team,

PenTest Labs dropped the final PT report (attached) and CatalystBank has asked for a packaged deliverable: the report PDF, an executive summary tailored for their InfoSec reviewers, an owner-by-item action plan (who's owning the fix, ETA, verification artifacts), and the evidence bundle (logs, config snapshots, screenshots). They want the package by EOD Thurs 8/6 to stay on their audit timeline.

Immediate asks:
- Monica: can you draft the executive summary and pull the remediation language?
- Diego: please locate the infra artifacts (network ACLs, ASG configs, AMI IDs, and the container image SHA) and put them in the evidence folder.
- Karthik/Evelyn: security review + sign-off on owner action plan and verification criteria.

I've attached the raw PT report from PenTest Labs (they also flagged three medium items that require engineering time). We should aim to have a single ZIP for CatalystBank that includes the PDF, exec summary, evidence bundle, and the owner_action_plan spreadsheet. I started JIRA SEC-7142 for tracking — Diego, please add sub-tasks for the infra items.

Thanks — Priyom

Attachments: CatalystBank-PT-Report-v2.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CatalystBank PT report — packaging + internal owners needed

Priyom —

Acknowledged. I'll collect the infra artifacts and upload to the shared Drive folder (link below) by EOD Wed. Quick inventory of what I'll include:
- VPC flow logs (last 90 days)
- Security group / NACL exports (as JSON)
- AMI and image SHAs used in prod clusters
- Kubernetes pod spec snapshots for the affected services
- CI pipeline run ids and hash for the deploy referenced in the PT timeline

Notes/questions: the pen test references an API endpoint that was deprecated in April — do you want us to include the deprecation ticket and timeline as part of the package? I can add a one-line note in the evidence README.

I'll create sub-tasks under SEC-7142 for each artifact and tag owners.

— Diego

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CatalystBank PT report — packaging + internal owners needed

Thanks for the callout. I can have the executive summary drafted by Wed afternoon. I'll keep it concise (1 page) with three sections: scope & timeline, high-level findings, and our remediation posture + verification plan.

Current remediation status (short):
- Medium issue #2 (auth header leakage): fix in progress, PR open, targeted deploy Fri 8/7. Verification: integration test + live traffic sampling (logs).
- Medium issue #4 (stale endpoint): marked deprecated, scheduled removal 8/21, mitigation documented.
- Low findings: docs updates + config hardening complete.

I'll attach the draft exec summary to the Drive and post a link when ready. Also — we should call out which items require a formal SOC2 control update vs. engineering-only remediation. Karthik, can you confirm control owners?

— Monica

On Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 11:05 AM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CatalystBank PT report — packaging + internal owners needed

All —

I'll take the lead on the owner_action_plan spreadsheet and map each PT finding to: owner, L0 remediation steps, verification artifacts, expected ETA, and whether the control mapping requires SOC2 evidence refresh. Preliminary ETA: I can have the completed owner_action_plan by Thu morning if everyone provides the artifact pointers today.

Required from Eng (Diego): the CI run ids and pod spec snapshots for the three services called out in the report.
Required from Monica: the executive summary wording for the remediation posture and the PR links.
Required from Evelyn: confirm that the verification criteria match our compliance evidence expectations and that nothing needs escalation to Legal/Privacy.

I'll open SEC-7142/owner-plan and assign rows to each of you. If anyone needs me to split items into separate JIRA sub-IDs for tracker purposes, say the word.

— Karthik

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 08:18 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: CatalystBank Security <security@catalystbank.com>, PenTest Labs <reports@pentestlabs.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CatalystBank PT report — packaged deliverable (CatalystBank)

CatalystBank / PenTest Labs —

Per our timeline, please find attached the packaged deliverable: CatalystBank-PT-Report-v2.pdf (original), PT-exec-summary.docx (tailored executive summary), evidence_bundle_20260806.zip (logs, config snapshots, pod specs), and owner_action_plan_CatalystBank.xlsx. The owner_action_plan has owner-assigned rows with ETA and verification columns; SEC-7142 in our tracker reflects the same assignments.

Short summary:
- We accept the three medium-priority findings and have owners assigned. One fix is scheduled for deploy 8/7; the other two have remediation plans with ETAs between 8/7–8/21.
- Evidence bundle contains the artifacts requested. See Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPTEvidence for the metadata README.
- Karthik and Evelyn have validated verification criteria for SOC2 mapping; if CatalystBank wants a control-specific letter, we can draft a short attestation once all fixes are verified.

Next steps requested from CatalystBank: please confirm receipt and whether you need any additional artifacts (packet hashes, or a time-windowed log export). PenTest Labs — please confirm you are comfortable with the way we summarized the findings for the exec summary.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CatalystBank-PT-Report-v2.pdf; PT-exec-summary.docx; evidence_bundle_20260806.zip; owner_action_plan_CatalystBank.xlsx
